what_to_detect: A spell is cast: it is put on the stack and its costs are paid, which the cost half of its resolution pair records (costs paid, outcome).
near_miss: No resolution-record near miss: a spell that cannot be cast is never put on the stack and appears only as a can_play false playability candidate.

what_to_detect: A spell on the stack whose characteristics (colour, type) are modified by a continuous effect that applies to the stack zone, so the changed characteristic decides a later outcome.
near_miss: A continuous effect that applies to permanents only and leaves the spell's characteristics alone.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose legal_targets are narrowed to fewer objects than its target specification allows, because a static requires a particular object be chosen if able; the excluded objects are on the fires side. A decision record lists no outside today, so legal_targets speak only for the inside.
near_miss: A candidate whose legal_targets are not narrowed by any must-target static.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost after adjustment is higher than its printed mana cost because a cost increase applies.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost_after_adjustment equals its printed cost.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost after adjustment is lower than its printed cost, bottoming out at zero, so it is affordable with less mana than printed.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost_after_adjustment equals its printed cost.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost holds a sacrifice part and whose cost_after_adjustment already counts a reduction from a static on a permanent that the sacrifice could take: the total cost is locked in before payment, so the candidate is affordable with the reduced mana.
near_miss: A candidate with a sacrifice part and no cost reduction, whose cost_after_adjustment equals its printed cost.

what_to_detect: A spell's total cost, mana and additional costs together, is paid in full: the cost half lists every cost component paid (mana and a sacrifice, discard, life or exile).
near_miss: No resolution-record near miss: a cast whose cost cannot be paid in full is never made and leaves no cost half.
record_fields: resolution/activation payload.costs (mana_by_color, tapped, sacrificed, discarded, life, exiled)

what_to_detect: A candidate that a casting prohibition would forbid for some proposal choice (X, mode, alternative cost) is still castable (can_play true), because another choice made during proposal avoids the prohibition.
near_miss: A candidate the prohibition forbids whatever is chosen: can_play false with static_prohibition among its failed_checks.

what_to_detect: A non-instant, non-flash spell is a castable candidate (can_play true) at a time only instant-speed casting allows, because a cast-as-though-flash permission applies.
near_miss: The same candidate outside its permission is not castable (can_play false, failed_checks casting_speed).

what_to_detect: A non-instant, non-flash spell is a castable candidate (can_play true) at a time only instant-speed casting allows, because a cast-as-though-flash permission applies.
near_miss: The same candidate outside its permission is not castable (can_play false, failed_checks casting_speed).

what_to_detect: A decision candidate that is castable from the library (top card) through a cast-from-library permission, split by the half's characteristics.
near_miss: A library candidate whose characteristics the permission does not allow (can_play false).
